name: @baton/desktop
author: baton contributors
description: baton desktop app (Electron) for macOS and Windows

scripts.build: tsc -b ../protocol ../providers ../server && npm run build -w @baton/web && tsc -b && node scripts/icons.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run stage && electron-builder --win --x64
